title: Hold a second-hand dealers licence
what: Deal in second-hand goods, or run a market where they are sold, only as a licensed second-hand dealer, and only at a place the licence authorises.

laws.title: Second-hand Dealers and Pawnbrokers Act 2003 (Qld)
laws.provisions: s 6(1), sch 3, definition of second-hand dealer, s 35(1)

sources.title: Second-hand Dealers and Pawnbrokers Act 2003 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on a business of dealing in second-hand property or act as a market operator unless the person is a second-hand dealer

sources.title: Second-hand Dealers and Pawnbrokers Act 2003 (Qld)
sources.quote: second-hand dealer means a person— (a) who— (i) carries on the business of dealing in second-hand property; or (ii) is a market operator; and (b) who holds a second-hand dealers licence

sources.title: Second-hand Dealers and Pawnbrokers Act 2003 (Qld)
sources.quote: A second-hand dealer must not carry on business as a second-hand dealer at a place other than an authorised place

administration.who: Chief executive of the department administering the Second-hand Dealers and Pawnbrokers Act 2003 (Qld)

sources.title: Second-hand Dealers and Pawnbrokers Act 2003 (Qld)
sources.locator: s 12, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current)
sources.quote: the chief executive must refuse to grant the licence if the chief executive is not satisfied the applicant is a suitable person to hold the licence.

reach.condition: if it buys or sells second-hand goods as the Act defines them
